records.title: Temporal convolutional transformer for EEG based motor imagery decoding
records.reason: 一次資料abstractおよび全文を確認。対象分野との技術的接続がなく、compute/memory/latency/throughput/KV-cache/quantization/offload/serving改善を扱わないためunrelated。 TCFormer combines CNN features, grouped-query Transformer attention and a temporal-convolution head for EEG motor-imagery classification. It improves task accuracy on EEG datasets, but it is not an LLM/KV-cache inference method and reports no LLM serving efficiency.

records.title: Quantization without Tears
records.reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 QwT adds a small linear structure to quantized networks and solves the calibration/accuracy adjustment in closed form in under two minutes. It evaluates vision, language and multimodal tasks; the paper motivates compression/acceleration but the reviewed results do not demonstrate a specific LLM serving latency or throughput gain.
